answer: Let standing flow like a river that only moves at calendar speed. Each identity starts at the nadir and earns nothing until it has woven its own sable thread of distinct dated work: one link per epoch, each link referencing the previous one and anchoring to a fresh public event that occurred after it. A farm can spawn a hundred accounts in an hour, but it cannot fast-forward the calendar or precompute the thread, so bulk creation buys delay, not payout.
